en: AI helped us build. We chose what mattered.
zh: AI让想法落地，判断让作品成立。
en_script:
Alright, you have seen what Civilization Voyage feels like to play.
I will now explain how we built it, and how we could turn it into a sustainable cultural product.

We used Lovable to share ideas and explore what the game could look like.
Then we used Claude for design, Codex for API work, and Grok for the frontend and 3D scenes.

We brought these parts together locally, tested the interactions, and updated the desktop app.

But building the game was only part of the work.

We still had to choose which stories belonged together, check their historical order, and make each choice clear to the player.

Look at the game on the right.
Behind this scene, the real question is:
What does the player understand—and what will they remember?

AI helped us turn ideas into something people could play.
Our job was to give that experience a clear purpose.

And that brings us to the business.
Before people spend money on our game, they spend time with it.
We need to make that time worthwhile.
zh_script:
大家已经看到了文明航程玩起来是什么样子。
接下来，我会介绍我们如何制作它，以及如何让它成为一个能够持续发展的文化产品。

我们用Lovable交流想法，探索游戏可能呈现的样子。
然后用Claude做设计、Codex处理API，以及Grok完成前端和3D场景。

我们在本机把这些部分整合起来，测试互动，并更新了桌面应用。

但把游戏做出来，只是其中一部分。

我们还要决定哪些故事应该放在一起，核对历史顺序，并让玩家看懂每一个选择。

请看右边的游戏画面。
在这幅场景背后，真正的问题是：
玩家理解了什么，又会记住什么？

AI帮助我们把想法变成了可以玩的作品。
我们的工作，是让这段体验有一个明确的目的。

这也引出了商业部分。
在为游戏花钱之前，人们先为它花时间。
我们需要让这段时间值得。

rehearsal.en:

rehearsal.en:

zh: 对标竞品，明确我们的优势
en_script:
These are the two products we chose as competitive benchmarks.
On the left is Discovery Tour. Its strength is the detail of its historical worlds, supported by experts.
In the middle is Minecraft Education. Its strength is its range: many subjects, ready-made lessons and tools for teachers.
Both offer useful experiences. But for our particular topic, someone would still need to select the material and connect it into a journey through Chinese and world histories.

On the right is our answer. Civilization Voyage already connects four eras and eight routes around technology and everyday life.
Players make a decision, meet its consequences, and look back on it at the end. For example, helping a neighbouring village uses supplies now, but can bring support later.
That is the difference we want people to remember: one journey, connected choices, and consequences that follow you.
We still need to test whether this helps people learn or saves teachers time. But it gives us a clear focus. Now, who might pay for it?
zh_script: 这是两款对标竞品。左边Discovery Tour的长处是专家参与的细致历史世界；中间Minecraft Education的长处是范围广，有多学科、现成课程和教师工具。但针对我们的特定主题，仍需要选材，把中外历史组织成连贯体验。右边是我们的回答：四时代八航线，围绕技术与日常生活，作决定、遇见后果、回港回顾。帮助邻村消耗眼前补给，却可能带来后续支援。希望观众记住：一段航程，连贯选择，持续的后果。学习和备课价值仍需验证，但产品定位已经清楚。接着问谁可能付费。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 依次指左栏Discovery Tour、中栏Minecraft Education。
rehearsal.en:

Both offer useful experiences. But for our particular topic, someone would still need to select the material and connect it into a journey through Chinese and world histories.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指右栏文明航程；讲邻村例子，重读“one journey, connected choices”。
rehearsal.en:
On the right is our answer. Civilization Voyage already connects four eras and eight routes around technology and everyday life.
Players make a decision, meet its consequences, and look back on it at the end. For example, helping a neighbouring village uses supplies now, but can bring support later.
That is the difference we want people to remember: one journey, connected choices, and consequences that follow you.
We still need to test whether this helps people learn or saves teachers time. But it gives us a clear focus. Now, who might pay for it?

en: One core experience. Three reasons to pay.
zh: 共同的内容基础，三种付费理由。
en_script:
This slide shows three customers, three offers, and three reasons to pay.
Start on the left. A player buys the full game for a proposed sixty-eight yuan. They are paying for the adventure: the stories, the choices and the world they can explore. New story packs could come later.

Now look at the middle picture. A story about industrial change becomes a classroom discussion guide. The teacher needs more than access to a game. They need help using it in a lesson.
Our proposed education service is twelve thousand yuan a year. It includes guides, two training sessions and limited support.

On the right, a story about communication becomes an exhibit idea. A museum could work with us on a local theme. The proposed price is sixty thousand yuan for one theme, three scenes and two review rounds.
These are test prices. The education and museum services are still proposals.
The shared idea is simple: develop good content once, then adapt it for different uses. But every extra piece of work must be included in the price.
zh_script: 三类客户、三种商品、三个付费理由。左边玩家以拟价68元买完整冒险，未来可以增加故事包。中间，工业故事成为讨论指南。教师需要的不只是进入游戏，还需要怎样把它用于课堂；拟议每年1.2万元的服务包括指南、两次培训和限定支持。右边通信史成为展陈概念，文博项目拟价6万元，限定一主题、三场景、两轮审读。这些是测试价格，教育和文博仍是规划。共同逻辑是：先做好内容，再适配不同用途；额外工作要体现在价格里。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指左图与薄荷绿¥68，讲玩家买什么。
rehearsal.en:
This slide shows three customers, three offers, and three reasons to pay.
Start on the left. A player buys the full game for a proposed sixty-eight yuan. They are paying for the adventure: the stories, the choices and the world they can explore. New story packs could come later.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指中间讨论指南与¥12,000，讲教师需要什么。
rehearsal.en:
Now look at the middle picture. A story about industrial change becomes a classroom discussion guide. The teacher needs more than access to a game. They need help using it in a lesson.
Our proposed education service is twelve thousand yuan a year. It includes guides, two training sessions and limited support.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指右侧展陈与¥60,000；最后回到内容复用与额外工作成本。
rehearsal.en:
On the right, a story about communication becomes an exhibit idea. A museum could work with us on a local theme. The proposed price is sixty thousand yuan for one theme, three scenes and two review rounds.
These are test prices. The education and museum services are still proposals.
The shared idea is simple: develop good content once, then adapt it for different uses. But every extra piece of work must be included in the price.

en: Growth must pay for the work behind it
zh: 增长，要能承担持续创作的成本。
en_script:
Let us follow the chart from left to right. These are assumptions for one year, not sales we have already made.
At the top, you can see our base case: two thousand paying players, ten institutions and two museum projects.
The blue bar is revenue: three hundred and seventy-six thousand yuan.

The first orange bar takes away the cost of delivery and finding customers. The green bar is what remains: one hundred and sixty thousand eight hundred yuan.
Then we subtract fixed investment of two hundred and forty thousand yuan. That takes us below zero. The final red bar shows a gap of seventy-nine thousand two hundred yuan.

So, even with those sales, the base case still makes a loss. That is why we should test before we expand.
Can we find customers at a reasonable cost? Can teachers use the materials again with less help? Can we build the next story without starting from zero?
Those answers will tell us whether this can become a lasting business. More sales only help if we can afford to deliver them.
zh_script: 从左向右看图，这是一年假设而非已实现销售。顶部是2000名玩家、10家机构、2个项目。蓝柱收入37.6万元，第一根橙柱扣交付与获客，绿柱剩16.08万元贡献。再扣24万元固定投入，降到零线以下，红柱缺口7.92万元。即使达到这些销量，基准仍亏损，所以先测试再扩张：获客是否合理，教师能否减少依赖并复用材料，新故事能否不从零开始？这些答案决定是否能持续。更多销售只有在交付成本可承受时才有意义。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指顶部数量，再指最左蓝色收入柱。
rehearsal.en:
Let us follow the chart from left to right. These are assumptions for one year, not sales we have already made.
At the top, you can see our base case: two thousand paying players, ten institutions and two museum projects.
The blue bar is revenue: three hundred and seventy-six thousand yuan.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 手势从左向右：橙色扣成本→绿色贡献→橙色固定投入→红色缺口。
rehearsal.en:
The first orange bar takes away the cost of delivery and finding customers. The green bar is what remains: one hundred and sixty thousand eight hundred yuan.
Then we subtract fixed investment of two hundred and forty thousand yuan. That takes us below zero. The final red bar shows a gap of seventy-nine thousand two hundred yuan.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 红色缺口处停一秒；抬头讲三个经营问题。
rehearsal.en:
So, even with those sales, the base case still makes a loss. That is why we should test before we expand.
Can we find customers at a reasonable cost? Can teachers use the materials again with less help? Can we build the next story without starting from zero?
Those answers will tell us whether this can become a lasting business. More sales only help if we can afford to deliver them.

zh: 让人愿意再来，让故事能够继续。
en_script:
The last slide brings the plan together.
On the left is a proposed budget of three hundred and sixty thousand yuan. The bars below show where it goes: fixed work, delivery float and a reserve.
Delivery float means cash to cover the wait between doing the work and getting paid. We do not count it again as an extra expense.

We would start with one hundred and twenty thousand yuan. Then we would follow the three steps on the right.
First, see whether people finish the game and choose to return. Next, test real payments and delivery costs. Then, add new stories and work with cultural partners.
We want each release to give people a reason to come back, and give us something useful to build on.

Let me end with the question behind the whole voyage: as our tools become more powerful, how do we choose to live together?
AI gives us the ability to build. We must decide what is worth building, and how to keep it alive.
That is what we want Civilization Voyage to become. Thank you.
zh_script: 最后把计划合起来。左侧36万元预算，下方条形图分固定工作、交付周转、储备；周转是做完到收到钱之间的现金，不重复计费。先投12万元，再按右侧三步：看用户是否玩完且主动再来，验证支付与交付成本，再增加故事与文化伙伴。每次更新应让用户愿意回来，也为下一次制作留下积累。最后看向观众：当工具越来越强大，我们选择怎样共同生活？AI给了制作能力，值得做什么、怎样持续，由我们决定。这就是文明航程想走向的方向。谢谢。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指左上预算与下面三根分配条。
rehearsal.en:
